# Extraction benchmark

Generated by benchmarks/bench.py. Command: `python benchmarks/bench.py`.

All numbers come from one machine and one run of the command above. Speed will differ on other machines. Precision and recall are copied from src/rfikit/measured.json (measured on synthetic data, full run, report seeds 101 to 130 for family A and the written set); they are not scored again here.

- machine: arm64
- OS: macOS-27.2.1-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O
- CPU count: 10
- Python: 3.13.13
- rfikit commit: 8d30dd7
